checked: The full twelve-cell grid produces exactly 72 comparison keys and every complete single-CV three-floor subset produces the corresponding 18 rows.
An entirely missing cell, method or replication, an individual missing fit, duplicates and unplanned keys reject rather than shrinking the planned Cartesian set.
Each included CV requires all three fixed floors; canonical physical design, truth and non-headline scope are enforced.

Every row retains matching actual and anchor identities, the fixed anchor floor, exact policy literal, root seed and integer source/gap/path spawn keys; equal replication labels alone do not establish pairing.
All estimators share the hashes for their own physical variant, while irregular variants may have distinct or coincident arrays.
CV=0 requires full retained numerical and diagnostic evidence equality across floors after excluding only actual cell identity and physical floor fields.
Malformed flags, status strings, numeric values, scientific metadata, source availability and missing required fields reject before contrast computation.
All-invalid rows and very large invalid candidates survive the planned denominators without mutation or overflow caused by using excluded candidates.
Disjoint valid-point sets retain their own counts but have undefined common-subset metrics; unavailable intervals with apparently covering endpoints still contribute zero operational coverage.
A single planned replication retains point metrics while withholding sample Monte Carlo uncertainty; zero RMSE and zero-truth mu retain the specified undefined quantities.
Negative natural-scale Wald lower limits remain unchanged and eligible for coverage.
A valid value with unrepresentable squared-error arithmetic blocks the table rather than being dropped or converted to a false available metric.
List, reordered list and DataFrame inputs give the same output without mutating retained input records.

concrete_review_finding_resolved.issue: A literal row carrying both a valid interval and a nonempty pipeline_error was initially accepted and counted as covering, although native source_records cannot emit that combination.
concrete_review_finding_resolved.preservation_regression: A valid retained point with an unavailable interval and nonempty pipeline_error remains in common-valid point metrics and counts as noncoverage operationally.
concrete_review_finding_resolved.repair: Nonempty pipeline_error with interval_valid true now rejects as inconsistent evidence.
concrete_review_finding_resolved.scientific_interpretation: This was a pre-data validation defect in the new comparison module, not an observed headline or exploratory method failure.

independent_test_execution.inputs: literal synthetic fit records; canonical cells and manually serialized spawn keys; no random generator or scientific sample construction

limitations: Exact paired uncertainty formulas and covariance-aware influence arithmetic are covered by the separately recorded mathematical review.
This module verifies address metadata and source-sharing claims; it does not regenerate source arrays or perform the planned full artifact audit.
Synthetic records are validation inputs and do not contribute to any scientific result.
This approval does not certify later execution, reporting, artifact audit or Week 7 completion.
